issues.label: Applicability of R.C. 2929.19(B)(1)(b) to juvenile-transferred defendants
issues.why: The court must determine whether the youth-consideration sentencing statute applies to Arrington's bindover case.

issues.label: Compliance with mandatory youth-consideration requirement
issues.why: Whether the trial court actually considered Arrington's youth and attendant characteristics before imposing an adult sentence.

issues.label: Standard of review under R.C. 2953.08(G)
issues.why: The appellate court must apply the correct standard for reviewing felony sentences.

issues.label: Whether sentence is contrary to law
issues.why: Central claim that the indefinite prison term violates statutory sentencing mandates.

issues.label: Application of State v. Patrick precedent
issues.why: Patrick governs whether youth must be considered when sentencing juvenile-transferred offenders.

issues.label: Plain error vs. preservation of sentencing objection
issues.why: Whether the youth-consideration error was preserved or reviewed for plain error under Crim.R. 52.

issues.label: Effect of guilty plea on appeal rights
issues.why: Whether the guilty plea waives or limits challenges to sentencing and counsel's performance.

issues.label: Ineffective assistance: deficient performance
issues.why: Whether counsel's failure to present mitigating youth factors fell below professional standards.

issues.label: Ineffective assistance: prejudice prong
issues.why: Whether a reasonable probability exists the sentence would differ absent counsel's omission.

issues.label: Adequacy of record showing youth mitigation
issues.why: Whether the psychological evaluation and record already contained youth factors the court considered.

issues.label: Reyna/indefinite sentencing under Reagan Tokes Law
issues.why: The indefinite 7-to-10.5-year term implicates the constitutionality and application of indefinite sentencing.

issues.label: Constitutional protections under Ohio Const. Art. I, §9
issues.why: Whether the sentence implicates cruel and unusual punishment concerns for youthful offenders.

issues.label: Immediate sentencing after plea propriety
issues.why: Whether proceeding directly to sentencing precluded meaningful presentation of mitigation.

issues.label: Validity of the underlying bindover procedure
issues.why: Whether the transfer's amenability and probable cause findings support adult jurisdiction and sentencing.

issues.label: Remedy if error found
issues.why: Whether resentencing or remand is the appropriate disposition for any statutory noncompliance.
